name: CoreWeave
overview: Large GPU cloud operator with growing reported revenue and active power, substantial secured and unsecured financing, and concentrated long-term customer exposure. Contract backlog and future lease commitments depend on infrastructure delivery; they are not cash or current revenue.

size.label: Large
size.basis: Provider-reported rounded equity market capitalization $23.69B for November 24, observed November 25. Page quotes November 24 close $42.61 at 16:00 EST; metadata says last updated November 23. Older October 30 issuer basic economic shares 556,125,724 × that closing price = $23.697B, consistent with rounding but not proof of no subsequent issuance. Not enterprise value or a live quote; current fully diluted share basis remains unverified. Large threshold: at least $10B.

facts.label: DDTL 4.0 — project-backed nonrecourse financing
facts.definition: Facility capacity is not drawn debt. March 2032 maturity; floating tranche SOFR + 2.25% or alternative-base option; fixed tranche Treasury benchmark + 2.00%; undrawn commitment fee 0.50%. Debt-table 7% is an accounting effective rate, not a single cash coupon.
facts.scope: CoreWeave Compute Acquisition Co. VIII subsidiary facility; Note 10
facts.verification: Reviewed against primary disclosure; USD millions converted to displayed billions where applicable.
facts.locator: Form 10-Q, Note 10 — Debt: September 30 debt obligations table (DDTL 4.0 $4,583 million principal) and Delayed Draw Term Loans subsection beginning In March 2026 (facility $8.5 billion; pricing, availability, payment triggers, security and maturity).
facts.excerpt:
Debt table (maturity | effective interest rate | September 2026 principal | December 2025 principal; USD millions): DDTL 4.0 Facility Mar 2032 7 % 4,583 —
Issuance table (date | stated interest | capacity, USD millions): DDTL 4.0 Facility March 2026 SOFR + 2.25 %;  Treasury + 2.00 % $ 8,500
The agreement provides an $ 8.5 billion DDTL facility (the "DDTL 4.0 Facility") available in one or more draws through June 30, 2027, the commitment termination date. As of September 30, 2026, the facility has $ 2.2 billion of outstanding floating-rate loan and $ 2.4 billion of outstanding fixed-rate loan. Amounts borrowed under the floating-rate commitments bear interest, at the Company's option, at daily compounded SOFR plus 2.25 % per annum or the alternative base rate plus 1.25 % per annum. Amounts borrowed under the fixed-rate commitments bear interest at 2.00 % per annum plus a blended rate based upon the applicable United States Treasury securities per the credit agreement at the time of the borrowing.The DDTL 4.0 Facility matures in March 2032.

facts.label: DDTL 5.5 — shorter-duration contract financing
facts.definition: August 2026 facility; Term SOFR + 5.50%, September 2031 maturity. Secured by subsidiary equity and assets, unconditionally guaranteed by CoreWeave; customer-contract and excess-cash-flow prepayment requirements. Debt-table 11% is effective interest, not the floating cash coupon.
facts.verification: Reviewed against primary disclosure; USD millions converted to displayed billions where applicable.
facts.locator: Form 10-Q, Note 10 — Debt: September 30 debt obligations table (DDTL 5.5 $1,555 million principal), issuance/stated-interest table ($2,600 million; Term SOFR + 5.50%) and DDTL 5.5 facility paragraphs on guarantees and prepayments.

Issuance table (date | stated interest | capacity, USD millions): DDTL 5.5 Facility August 2026 Term SOFR + 5.50 % $ 2,600
The agreement provides a $ 2.6 billion DDTL facility (the "DDTL 5.5 Facility") available in one or more draws through December 31, 2026, the commitment termination date. The principal amount of the DDTL 5.5 Facility is required to be repaid in monthly installments, beginning in February 2027, with the expected final payment due in July 2031.

questions: Freshness: SEC submissions index re-read November 25 includes eight November 24 Form 4 filings; latest periodic filing remains November 12 Q3 Form 10-Q and latest 8-K in retrieved list is November 10. This updates the earlier November 24 observation without treating that historical snapshot as an error. Reviewed Form 4 sales describe tax withholding associated with vesting; do not label them discretionary bearish sales.

Issuer freshness: the November 23 UBS conference release was re-read November 24. The dynamic issuer news/event indexes did not expose a complete rendered list, so issuer-channel coverage is partial. The next earnings release date remains unconfirmed; the December 1 conference is not earnings.

Which customer contracts and sites underwrite each facility, and what delivery, cancellation, collateral, amortization, covenant and cash-sweep triggers apply? This prototype is a reviewed selection, not every credit agreement or a complete covenant model.
How much of the prospective $9B customer prepayment/deposit collection has actually arrived, and what restrictions, refund or cancellation terms attach? Do not add it to September 30 cash.
What GPU generation mix, installed GPU count, utilization and revenue-producing capacity reconcile to active power? The reviewed platform milestone and GW figures cannot establish these.
